papers.title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
papers.translated_title: AnyCam：任何事物皆可表征相机以用于视频生成
papers.author: Weijie Lyu
papers.summary: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
papers.translated_summary: 相机控制的视频生成沿目标相机轨迹重新渲染视频，然而围绕物体移动相机——这是改变以物体为中心场景视角的最自然方式——仍然困难。现有方法要么以相机参数为条件，而相机参数在单目视频中具有尺度歧义，要么以显式几何如变形点云或深度为条件，而后者在大视角变化下会失效。我们提出 AnyCam，一种用场景中的锚定物体来表示相机的方法：我们在 3D 中重建该物体并沿目标轨迹渲染它，这是一种尺度感知、视角完整且易于相对于物体指定的相机信号。视频扩散模型将源视频的内容和动态迁移到新视角。其 H-Concat 布局在时间上对齐源帧和目标帧，因此该模型可以蒸馏为 AnyCam-AR，一个用于即时相机控制的流式少步生成器。两个模型均在配对的视频上训练，这些视频带有来自多相机视频和静态场景采集的像素对齐锚定渲染。在不同数据集和轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam 在相机控制和视觉质量方面优于相机控制的视频生成和 3D 重建方法。

papers.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.translated_title: 用智能体视觉推理跟踪任意点
papers.author: Xuweiyi Chen
papers.summary: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
papers.translated_summary: 通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在目标检测和视频识别等诸多领域已超越专家视觉模型。然而，点对应关系对VLM而言颇具挑战，因为它超越了目标级识别：它要求在观测之间对同一物理表面点进行像素级定位，即使外观发生变化或该点消失后又重新出现。本文提出AgenTAP，一种基于VLM的智能体，直接预测点坐标与可见性，并对视频进行主动推理。该智能体从自身估计出发，自主选择要检查的内容，并利用由此获得的证据验证点的身份并精化其预测。在GPT-6 Astra上，它在点定位与可见性预测两方面均超越专家视觉模型，且无需针对对应关系进行微调。我们进一步利用AgenTAP在点消失后重新识别物理点并重连碎片化轨迹，构建了EgoTAP-4D——一个长时真实世界第一人称视频中3D点轨迹的数据集。在采样的重新出现点上，其预测接近人类一致性水平，且将EgoTAP-4D加入D4RT训练可提升平均3D跟踪性能。

papers.title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
papers.translated_title: AI原生自编码器通信的频谱自适应与迁移学习
papers.author: Yalin E. Sagduyu
papers.summary: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. We further formulate layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem that identifies the most informative parameters to update during adaptation. This preserves the learned signal geometry and the deep decision structure while adapting lightweight front ends to fading- and impairment-induced mixing. For AE communications, we show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach the BER of fully retrained models. We provide a layer-wise study and quantify resource-performance trade-offs, showing that modest adaptation substantially reduces BER while cutting training time, multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters for resource-efficient implementation.
papers.translated_summary: 端到端物理层学习用自编码器（AE）取代了独立的调制、编码和检测操作，该自编码器由发射机和接收机处联合训练的编码器-解码器对组成。本文研究基于自编码器的AI原生通信，并量化其对信道模型中训练-测试失配的敏感性。仅在AWGN信道上训练的模型在匹配条件下可实现低误码率（BER），但在存在实际前端损伤的瑞利衰落信道上会严重退化。为减少适应新信道条件所需的时间和能量，我们提出一种低时延迁移学习流程，该流程从AWGN预训练系统出发，仅微调发射机和接收机层的一小部分子集，同时冻结其余部分。我们进一步将层选择表述为预算约束优化问题，以识别适应过程中最具信息量的待更新参数。这在对轻量前端进行适应以应对衰落和损伤引起的混合的同时，保持了已学习的信号几何结构和深层判决结构。对于自编码器通信，我们表明部分更新可消除失配引起的误码率底限，并接近完全重训练模型的BER。我们提供了逐层研究并量化了资源-性能权衡，表明适度适应可大幅降低BER，同时减少训练时间、乘累加（MAC）操作、能耗以及更新参数的比例，从而实现资源高效的实现。

papers.title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
papers.translated_title: 在没有视频的情况下改进和扩展视频编辑能力
papers.author: Ji Xie
papers.summary: Image editing models can follow a wide range of instructions, but video editing models still lag behind, limited in part by the difficulty of collecting paired source and edited videos. Is it possible to transfer advanced image editing capabilities to video editors without new paired videos? We introduce Image-to-Video Transfer (I2VT), which improves pretrained video editors and expands them to new editing tasks using an image editor. It enables efficient post-training with no architectural changes and no new videos, using only individual images. Our key idea is to let the video editor role-play as an image editor: it edits an image as a one-frame video, with the image editor guiding the video editor's predictions at each denoising step. Although the video editor sees only single images during training, at test time it applies the improved and expanded capabilities to whole video clips while preserving temporal consistency. To push the boundaries of video editing, we introduce OpenVE++, an extension of OpenVE-Bench that adds four new editing tasks useful for video production, including action changes, expression changes, body movements, and scene relighting. Our experiments across three different video editors show that I2VT improves existing editing capabilities and expands them to new tasks, and our models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.
papers.translated_summary: 图像编辑模型能够遵循广泛的指令，但视频编辑模型仍然落后，部分原因是难以收集成对的源视频和编辑后视频。是否有可能在没有新配对视频的情况下，将先进的图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑器？我们引入图像到视频迁移（I2VT），它利用图像编辑器改进预训练的视频编辑器，并将其扩展到新的编辑任务。它能够实现高效的后训练，无需架构更改，也无需新视频，仅使用单张图像。我们的核心思想是让视频编辑器角色扮演为图像编辑器：它将图像作为单帧视频进行编辑，由图像编辑器在每个去噪步骤中引导视频编辑器的预测。尽管视频编辑器在训练期间只看到单张图像，但在测试时它将改进和扩展的能力应用于整个视频片段，同时保持时间一致性。为了推动视频编辑的边界，我们引入OpenVE++，它是OpenVE-Bench的扩展，增加了四个对视频制作有用的新编辑任务，包括动作变化、表情变化、身体运动和场景重光照。我们在三种不同的视频编辑器上进行的实验表明，I2VT改进了现有的编辑能力并将其扩展到新任务，我们的模型在OpenVE-Bench和OpenVE++上均达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能。

papers.title: LuxAvatar: Real-Time Relightable Head Avatars via Causal Neural Shading of 3D Intrinsic Proxies
papers.translated_title: LuxAvatar：通过3D内在代理的因果神经着色实现实时可重光照头部虚拟形象
papers.author: Yipengjing Sun
papers.summary: We present LuxAvatar, a feed-forward framework for real-time head avatar animation and relighting from a single portrait. To achieve both 3D controllability and complex facial light transport, we factorize avatar synthesis into an animatable 3D intrinsic Gaussian proxy and a causal autoregressive neural shader. This proxy disentangles canonical geometry and reflectance attributes, rapidly rasterizing deformed Gaussians into view- and motion-consistent PBR buffers. Conditioned on these buffers, our neural shader formulates forward rendering as a conditional video diffusion process, bypassing explicit PBR computation to synthesize realistic shading effects under target illumination. We achieve real-time streaming through heterogeneous distillation from a pretrained multi-step bidirectional relighting teacher to a two-step causal autoregressive neural shader, inheriting broad synthetic lighting priors while minimizing conditioning and decoding latency. To further specialize these priors to human heads, we construct a hybrid relighting dataset for domain-specific fine-tuning, capturing authentic facial dynamics and physically grounded light transport. Extensive experiments show that our framework enables 3D-controllable, real-time portrait animation and relighting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity, motion control, and lighting accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出LuxAvatar，一个前馈框架，用于从单张肖像实现实时头部化身动画与重光照。为实现3D可控性与复杂面部光传输，我们将化身合成分解为可动画的3D内在高斯代理与因果自回归神经着色器。该代理分离规范几何与反射率属性，将变形高斯快速光栅化为视角与运动一致的PBR缓冲区。以这些缓冲区为条件，我们的神经着色器将前向渲染表述为条件视频扩散过程，绕过显式PBR计算，在目标光照下合成逼真着色效果。我们通过异构蒸馏从预训练多步双向重光照教师模型到两步因果自回归神经着色器，实现实时流式传输，继承广泛合成光照先验，同时最小化条件与解码延迟。为进一步将这些先验专门化到人头，我们构建混合重光照数据集用于领域特定微调，捕捉真实面部动态与物理基础光传输。大量实验表明，我们的框架实现3D可控、实时肖像动画与重光照，在视觉保真度、运动控制与光照准确性上优于最先进方法。

papers.title: A Mesh for Every Moment
papers.translated_title: 每一刻的网格
papers.author: Roy Or-El
papers.summary: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame. Existing dynamic Gaussian splatting methods either model appearance alone or target isolated objects segmented by foreground masks, and all of them recover meshes by TSDF fusion or Poisson reconstruction, whose fixed grids limit the detail they can capture. At the core of MEMO is a per-Gaussian motion model inspired by Gaussian processes, which represents each Gaussian's position and rotation over time as a combination of temporal Gaussian kernels. The model keeps every Gaussian a valid surface element throughout the sequence and carries an implicit representation of the dynamic geometry, so a mesh can be derived at any time from a field defined by the Gaussians. Although common in real captures, large and fast motion poses a challenge that dynamic Gaussian splatting methods usually overlook. To account for it, we design a track-based initialization scheme that fits each Gaussian's initial trajectory to point tracks in closed form. We evaluate MEMO on Blender-Moments, a new benchmark of nine animated scenes with ground-truth meshes at every frame, and on two real-world datasets. MEMO reconstructs the most accurate geometry among state-of-the-art methods, and remains competitive in novel-view synthesis and training time. Project page: https://memo-4d.github.io
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出MEMO（a Mesh for Every MOment），一种重建完整动态场景几何的方法，该场景由多台同步相机捕获，并在每一帧提取网格。现有的动态高斯泼溅方法要么仅建模外观，要么针对由前景掩码分割出的孤立物体，并且它们都通过TSDF融合或泊松重建来恢复网格，其固定网格限制了所能捕获的细节。MEMO的核心是一种受高斯过程启发的逐高斯运动模型，它将每个高斯的位置和旋转随时间表示为时间高斯核的组合。该模型在整个序列中保持每个高斯为有效的表面元素，并携带动态几何的隐式表示，因此可以在任何时刻从高斯定义的场中导出网格。尽管在真实捕获中很常见，但大幅度快速运动构成了动态高斯泼溅方法通常忽视的挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们设计了一种基于轨迹的初始化方案，以闭式形式将每个高斯的初始轨迹拟合到点轨迹。我们在Blender-Moments（一个包含九个动画场景、每帧均有真值网格的新基准）和两个真实世界数据集上评估MEMO。MEMO在最先进方法中重建出最准确的几何，并在新视角合成和训练时间方面保持竞争力。项目页面：https://memo-4d.github.io

papers.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
papers.translated_title: 标记化不在APX中
papers.author: Violeta Kastreva
papers.summary: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
papers.translated_summary: 在本文中，我们证明除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能够找到一个其目标值在最优值任意常数倍范围内的分词器，这意味着分词不属于APX复杂性类。我们针对直接分词和自底向上分词，在压缩目标或一元对数似然目标下，以及对于二进制或更大字母表，证明了这一点。我们进一步表明，即使在单字母表上，直接分词也是APX困难的，因此不存在多项式时间近似方案。

papers.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
papers.translated_title: 图像生成能帮助视觉推理吗？一项实证研究
papers.author: Xueyang Yu
papers.summary: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
papers.translated_summary: 语言模型以词语思考，那么多模态模型可能以图像思考。我们测试生成的辅助图像能否改善视觉问题的答案。模型先描述它需要的辅助图像，然后结合原始图像和生成图像一起作答。在13组视觉语言模型与生成器配对中，生成使平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，在十个任务中有九个出现下降。两个统一模型BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B各自在八个任务上损失准确率。在VSTAR上，向相同的规划提示中添加生成图像使准确率下降10.47个百分点。重复的图像编辑在不同任务上产生不同结果。ChartQAPro和MathVista始终低于其无生成基线，而ERQA在十次编辑后提升了三个百分点。

papers.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
papers.translated_title: 攻击策略选择可能误导监控评估者
papers.author: Charlie Griffin
papers.summary: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.
papers.translated_summary: AI监控器——即标记AI智能体危险行为的分类器——通常使用由攻击策略生成的对话记录进行评估，这些攻击策略充当部署中危险行为的代理。我们以一个前生产环境的OpenAI监控器作为案例研究进行评估，发现测得的假阴性率对生成攻击策略的方法以及该方法内所应用的优化水平都高度敏感。在单一方法（强化学习）的不同优化水平下，该比率从0.5%到20.8%不等；在各方法最佳观测优化水平下（优化提示词对比对话记录编辑），该比率从6.4%到23.0%不等。每个攻击策略都仅针对代理监控器开发：所有报告的结果都显示攻击能够迁移到留出的GPT-5.4目标监控器上。我们的结果表明，监控器规避评估很容易产生误导：仅使用基本攻击方法的评估可能会让人错误地确信监控器很强。对攻击策略选择的敏感性带来了一个问题：要将任何特定结果解释为关于部署性能的证据，需要提供正当性论证。攻击策略生成的对话记录是监控器在部署中必须标记的危险行为的代理。这些代理可能引入可见的伪影，例如对监控器所见的指令中不存在的“侧任务”进行推理，从而影响监控器的判断。鉴于上述敏感性，代理的选择可能改变评估的结论。因此，要将这些结果解读为关于部署的证据，需要单独提供合法性论证，说明这些代理为何具有信息量，包括对保守性的任何辩护。给出令人信服的论证仍然是一个未解决的问题。

papers.title: DynMF2: Rigid Motion Factorization by Expectation-Maximization for Monocular 4D Reconstruction and Motion Segmentation
papers.translated_title: DynMF2：基于期望最大化的刚体运动分解用于单目4D重建与运动分割
papers.author: Agelos Kratimenos
papers.summary: A single casual video leaves a moving scene under-determined: a point seen once from each place can slide toward or away from the camera and still match every frame. We constrain the reconstruction with the structure of the motion itself. Building on DynMF, we model a scene's motion as a handful of SE(3) trajectories, each rigid, and let every point follow one of them alone, never a blend. DynMF2 computes this factorization directly from 3D point trajectories, with no rendering, by Expectation-Maximization (EM). Its M-step fits, in closed form, every rigid motion to the points assigned to it, and its E-step reassigns every point to the motion that explains it with the least error. The background is simply one more motion, the camera's, so no masks are needed. Three tools then revise the factorization: requery adds trajectories where the rendering shows parts the tracker missed, merge joins motions that move together, and split separates those that do not. Thus the number of motions follows the scene. Without masks, DynMF2 clearly outperforms the mask-based baselines in view synthesis on iPhone and NVIDIA and in 3D tracking on iPhone. It recovers what masks leave out, from thin parts and details to small movers far in the background. Its motions segment the moving parts of MOVi-F and iTACO scenes competitively, although DynMF2 is never trained to segment. What moves in a scene is not decided in advance: it emerges from the rigid motions themselves.
papers.translated_summary: 单段随意拍摄的视频会使动态场景欠定：从每个视角仅观测一次的点可以沿朝向或远离相机的方向滑动，却仍与每一帧匹配。我们利用运动本身的结构来约束重建。基于DynMF，我们将场景运动建模为少量SE(3)轨迹，每条轨迹均为刚性，并让每个点仅跟随其中一条轨迹，绝不混合。DynMF2通过期望最大化（EM）直接从3D点轨迹计算该分解，无需渲染。其M步以闭式解将每条刚性运动拟合到分配给它的点，其E步将每个点重新分配给解释误差最小的运动。背景只是多出一条运动——相机的运动，因此无需掩码。随后三种工具修正该分解：requery在渲染显示跟踪器遗漏部分的位置添加轨迹，merge合并一起运动的运动，split分离不一起运动的运动。因此运动数量随场景而定。无需掩码，DynMF2在iPhone和NVIDIA的视图合成以及iPhone的3D跟踪上明显优于基于掩码的基线。它能恢复掩码遗漏的内容，从细小部件和细节到背景深处的小型运动物体。其运动对MOVi-F和iTACO场景中运动部分的分割具有竞争力，尽管DynMF2从未被训练用于分割。场景中什么在运动并非预先决定：它从刚性运动本身中涌现。

papers.title: Baseline Predictors of Craving Reduction Following Non-Invasive Neuromodulation: A Computational Modeling Approach
papers.translated_title: 非侵入性神经调控后渴求减少的基线预测因素：一种计算建模方法
papers.author: Kang, J.
papers.summary: Background: Alcohol craving is a clinically relevant symptom with an established neurobiological basis and has emerged as a treatment target. Non-invasive neuromodulation has shown potential for reducing craving, but substantial inter-individual variability in response is a pervasive challenge. This study examined whether baseline computational parameters predicted treatment response following neuromodulation. Methods: This secondary analysis of an open-label, randomized trial included 58 individuals with subclinical alcohol use who received transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS), transcranial photobiomodulation (tPBM), or combined taVNS + tPBM for five weeks. Baseline computational measures from Delay Discounting, Choice under Risk and Ambiguity, and Loss Aversion Tasks were examined as predictors of treatment response. Elastic net regularization was used to identify markers associated with Reliable Change Index (RCI)-defined responder status, alongside demographic variables, intervention condition, and baseline craving. Results: Of the 58 participants, 24 were classified as treatment responders. The elastic net model showed a mean test AUC of 0.66 across 1,000 iterations, indicating modest predictive performance. Baseline craving, intervention condition, age, sex, and computational modeling parameters contributed to responder status: Higher loss aversion and lower risk sensitivity were associated with a greater likelihood of responder status. Conclusions: Baseline computational measures, particularly loss aversion and risk sensitivity, may serve as candidate behavioral markers associated with craving reduction following non-invasive neuromodulation. Given the open-label design, these findings represent an initial proof-of-concept. Future sham-controlled studies are needed to determine whether these parameters are associated with stimulation-specific responses or more general susceptibility to behavioral change.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：酒精渴求是一种具有明确神经生物学基础的临床相关症状，并已成为治疗靶点。非侵入性神经调控已显示出减少渴求的潜力，但个体间反应差异较大是一个普遍挑战。本研究检验了基线计算参数是否能预测神经调控后的治疗反应。方法：本开放标签随机试验的二次分析纳入58名亚临床酒精使用者，他们接受经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）、经颅光生物调节（tPBM）或taVNS+tPBM联合治疗五周。研究检验了延迟折扣、风险和模糊条件下选择以及损失厌恶任务的基线计算指标作为治疗反应的预测因子。使用弹性网正则化识别与可靠变化指数（RCI）定义的应答者状态相关的标志物，同时纳入人口学变量、干预条件和基线渴求。结果：58名参与者中，24名被归类为治疗应答者。弹性网模型在1,000次迭代中的平均测试AUC为0.66，表明预测性能中等。基线渴求、干预条件、年龄、性别和计算建模参数对应答者状态有贡献：较高的损失厌恶和较低的风险敏感性 associated with 更高的应答者状态可能性。结论：基线计算指标，特别是损失厌恶和风险敏感性，可能作为与非侵入性神经调控后渴求减少相关的候选行为标志物。鉴于开放标签设计，这些发现代表初步的概念验证。未来需要假刺激对照研究来确定这些参数是与刺激特异性反应相关，还是与更一般的行为改变易感性相关。

papers.title: Enhanced KNa1.1 Channel Underlies Cortical Hyperexcitability and Seizure Susceptibility after Traumatic Brain Injury
papers.translated_title: 增强的KNa1.1通道是创伤性脑损伤后皮层过度兴奋和癫痫易感性的基础
papers.author: Liu, R.
papers.summary: Pathogenic variants of the sodium-activated potassium channel KNa1.1 have been reported in multiple epileptic disorders. However, whether and how KNa1.1 channel is involved in epileptogenesis after traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains unknown. Firstly, we used behavioral monitoring and EEG recording to examine physiological property, spontaneous seizure activity, and seizure susceptibility after TBI. We explored the changes of KNa1.1 channel following TBI, including changes of subcellular distribution and expression pattern. Meanwhile, we performed patch-clamp recording to detect the neuronal excitability. Furthermore, we built TBI model using kcnt1-/- mice and compared seizure susceptibility and electrophysiological properties with those of wild-type mice. We found severity-dependent seizure susceptibility in different degree of injured mice. Meanwhile, increased neuronal expression of KNa1.1 channel around the lesion was also observed following TBI, accompanied by a reduced firing rate of interneurons and imbalanced excitation and inhibition (E/I). Although the maximum frequency of action potential of kcnt1-/- neurons was increased, kcnt1-/- mice displayed decreased seizure susceptibility to the pentylenetetrazole (PTZ) after TBI. In kcnt1-/- mice, TBI did not significantly alter afterhyperpolarization amplitude or action-potential firing frequency in pyramidal neurons or interneurons; although the frequencies of both sEPSCs and sIPSCs increased, the E/I ratio remained unchanged. Taken together, this study suggests that enhancedKNa1.1 expression after TBI contributes to disputed E/I balance and seizure susceptibility, and that KNa1.1 might be a potential therapeutic target for reducing seizure susceptibility after TBI.
papers.translated_summary: 钠激活钾通道KNa1.1的致病性变异已在多种癫痫性疾病中被报道。然而，KNa1.1通道是否以及如何参与创伤性脑损伤（TBI）后的癫痫发生仍不清楚。首先，我们采用行为监测和脑电图记录来检测TBI后的生理特性、自发性癫痫发作活动和癫痫易感性。我们探究了TBI后KNa1.1通道的变化，包括亚细胞分布和表达模式的变化。同时，我们进行膜片钳记录以检测神经元兴奋性。此外，我们使用kcnt1-/-小鼠建立TBI模型，并将其癫痫易感性和电生理特性与野生型小鼠进行比较。我们发现不同损伤程度小鼠的癫痫易感性呈严重程度依赖性。同时，TBI后还观察到病灶周围KNa1.1通道的神经元表达增加，伴随中间神经元放电频率降低和兴奋/抑制（E/I）失衡。尽管kcnt1-/-神经元动作电位的最大频率增加，但kcnt1-/-小鼠在TBI后对戊四氮（PTZ）的癫痫易感性降低。在kcnt1-/-小鼠中，TBI未显著改变锥体神经元或中间神经元的后超极化幅度或动作电位放电频率；尽管sEPSCs和sIPSCs的频率均增加，但E/I比值保持不变。综上所述，本研究表明TBI后KNa1.1表达增强导致了E/I平衡紊乱和癫痫易感性，且KNa1.1可能是降低TBI后癫痫易感性的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: EpiState-T for representing epigenetic states across time
papers.translated_title: EpiState-T 用于表示跨时间的表观遗传状态
papers.author: Choi, J. S.
papers.summary: Epigenetic information is central to cellular identity, aging and rejuvenation. Unlike the relatively stable genomic sequence shared by most somatic cells, epigenetic states vary across cells and time, making their dynamics difficult to reconstruct from sparse experimental measurements. We introduce EpiState-T, the Temporal Epigenetic State Tensor, to represent selected epigenetic states across intervals and distinguish an observed trajectory from the use of a retained record. In a ten-cell simulation, an explicit reader can act on each cells surviving baseline record. Across 500 paired simulations, mean final distance to the cells own baseline was 0.736 with reading disabled, 0.182 with correctly assigned records and 0.402 with reassigned records. These differences follow from the specified reader. We separately applied the observation and transition tensors to 859,151 CpGs measured in three donor-associated fibroblast cultures before, during and after transient reprogramming. Among sites ending within 0.05 methylation units of baseline, 9.75-15.72% had first departed in treated cultures, compared with 5.37-9.91% in matched mock cultures. The intermediate measurement therefore distinguishes paths that an endpoint comparison merges. These are paths of population measurements: the human data do not track individual cells or establish that cells read a historical record. EpiState-T provides an initial mathematical framework for investigating temporal epigenetic information while keeping state representation, observed change and proposed biological mechanisms distinct.
papers.translated_summary: 表观遗传信息对细胞身份、衰老与 rejuvenation 至关重要。与大多数体细胞共享的相对稳定的基因组序列不同，表观遗传状态随细胞和时间而变化，使其动态难以从稀疏的实验测量中重建。我们引入 EpiState-T，即时间表观遗传状态张量，用以表示跨区间的选定表观遗传状态，并区分观测轨迹与使用保留记录的情形。在一个十细胞模拟中，一个显式读取器可作用于每个细胞存活的基线记录。在500对配对模拟中，读取禁用时最终与细胞自身基线的平均距离为0.736，正确分配记录时为0.182，重新分配记录时为0.402。这些差异源于所指定的读取器。我们分别将观测张量和转移张量应用于三种供体相关成纤维细胞培养物在短暂重编程之前、期间和之后测量的859，151个CpG。在最终甲基化水平处于基线0.05个甲基化单位以内的位点中，9.75-15.72%在处理培养物中首先偏离，而匹配的模拟培养物中为5.37-9.91%。因此，中间测量区分了终点比较所合并的路径。这些是群体测量的路径：人类数据并未追踪单个细胞，也未确立细胞会读取历史记录。EpiState-T 提供了一个初步的数学框架，用于研究时间表观遗传信息，同时使状态表示、观测变化和所提出的生物学机制保持区分。

papers.title: Understanding robustness and enabling remediation of neuroimaging-based deep neural networks for digital security: Semantic segmentation of brain tumors as illustrative study
papers.translated_title: 理解鲁棒性并实现基于神经影像的深度神经网络在数字安全中的修复：以脑肿瘤语义分割为示例研究
papers.author: Mankar, M.
papers.summary: BackgroundApplications of deep learning models in neuroimaging have significantly advanced translational neuroscience, offering substantial benefits to human health. However, recent cybersecurity threats have undermined the reliability of digital neuroscience tools, posing challenges to the clinical neuroscience community. A critical issue is the automated semantic segmentation of malignant or premalignant brain tumors, essential for neurosurgery and radiotherapy planning. New methodsThis study investigates the robustness of customary deep learning models such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and more recent Vision Transformers (ViTs) in semantic segmentation against adversarial attacks. We assess the performance of CNNs and ViTs under ideal nonhostile conditions and then under cybersecurity threats. ResultsOur findings reveal that while CNNs perform well in ideal conditions, their efficiency sharply declines under adversarial perturbations. In contrast, ViTs maintain their segmentation performance even when subjected to adversarial attacks. This study is the first to apply Visual Transformers for cybersecurity challenge, leveraging advanced capabilities of VITs to enhance robustness against digital perturbations. Comparison with existing methodsCompared to CNNs, which are widely used for neuroimages but vulnerable to adversarial attacks, ViTs demonstrate superior resilience. Our research highlights that ViTs are as effective as CNNs under ideal conditions but offer enhanced protection from cybersecurity angle, making them a more robust choice for neuroimaging applications. ConclusionOur results indicate that for large-scale segmentation operation in neuroimaging, such as lesion segmentation tasks, ViT-based models should be preferred over CNN-based models. This shift could provide inherent protection against prevalent digital threats, ensuring more reliable and secure neuroimaging diagnostics.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：深度学习模型在神经影像中的应用显著推动了转化神经科学的发展，对人类健康带来了实质性益处。然而，近期网络安全威胁削弱了数字神经科学工具的可靠性，给临床神经科学界带来了挑战。一个关键问题是恶性或癌前脑肿瘤的自动化语义分割，这对于神经外科和放射治疗规划至关重要。新方法：本研究考察了卷积神经网络（CNNs）等常规深度学习模型以及较新的视觉Transformer（ViTs）在语义分割中对抗对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。我们评估了CNNs和ViTs在理想非敌意条件下的性能，随后评估其在网络安全威胁下的表现。结果：我们的研究结果表明，CNNs在理想条件下表现良好，但其效率在对抗性扰动下急剧下降。相比之下，ViTs即使在遭受对抗性攻击时也能保持其分割性能。本研究首次将视觉Transformer应用于网络安全挑战，利用ViTs的先进能力增强对数字扰动的鲁棒性。与现有方法的比较：与广泛用于神经影像但易受对抗性攻击的CNNs相比，ViTs展现出更优越的韧性。我们的研究强调，ViTs在理想条件下与CNNs同样有效，但从网络安全角度提供了增强的保护，使其成为神经影像应用中更稳健的选择。结论：我们的结果表明，对于神经影像中的大规模分割操作，如病灶分割任务，应优先选择基于ViT的模型而非基于CNN的模型。这一转变可提供对普遍数字威胁的内在防护，确保更可靠和安全的神经影像诊断。

papers.title: Dynamic hippocampal and cortical signatures of naturalistic event memory
papers.translated_title: 自然情境事件记忆的海马与皮层动态特征
papers.author: Silva, M.
papers.summary: Remembering temporally extended experiences requires integrating information over time into coherent event representations that can be stored and later retrieved. This process places changing demands on memory as an event unfolds: event representations must be reset at the beginning, connected into a unified model during the event, and stored in long-term memory at the end. We hypothesized that oscillatory dynamics, by coordinating communication across regions and organizing neural activity in time, provide a flexible mechanism for meeting these changing demands. However, most evidence comes from discrete-stimulus paradigms, leaving unclear how they support continuous experience. We recorded intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) while participants watched a movie and later freely recalled it, and tested how power, phase synchrony and alignment at the beginning, middle, and end of each event related to subsequent memory. At beginnings, remembered events showed reduced gamma power and increased hippocampal-frontal synchrony. Within an event, memory was predicted by increasing temporal gamma power and hippocampal-temporal gamma synchrony, consistent with progressive binding of information. At event endings, memory was reflected by increased hippocampal theta power and phase resetting. Together these results provide a new perspective on how the brain supports memory in naturalistic settings, showing that it does not rest on one sustained encoding state. Instead, it requires temporal coordination of oscillatory states across brain regions and event phases, in which stable states support ongoing representation while transient, boundary-driven reorganization of hippocampal-cortical networks switches the system between storing the completed event and encoding the next. Significance StatementTheories about how brain rhythms support memory have assumed a single optimal brain state for encoding new information, based on studies presenting discrete items, such as words or images. Real-world experience, however, is continuous: events unfold over time and are encoded as connected memory traces. By recording electrical brain activity while patients watched and recalled a 50-minute film, we find that remembering an event depends not on one static encoding state but on a dynamic sequence of brain rhythms and hippocampal-cortical coordination that change as the event begins, unfolds, and ends. These findings show that previous discrete-item paradigms capture only a snapshot of one step in memory formation and reveal how the brain converts continuous experience into lasting memories.
papers.translated_summary: 记住时间上延展的经历需要将信息随时间整合为连贯的事件表征，这些表征能够被存储并随后提取。这一过程随着事件的展开对记忆提出不断变化的需求：事件表征必须在开始时被重置，在事件进行中被连接为统一模型，并在结束时存储到长时记忆中。我们假设，振荡动力学通过协调跨区域通信并在时间上组织神经活动，为满足这些变化的需求提供了一种灵活机制。然而，大多数证据来自离散刺激范式，尚不清楚它们如何支持连续体验。我们在参与者观看电影并随后自由回忆时记录了颅内脑电图（iEEG），并检验了每个事件开始、中间和结束时功率、相位同步和相位对齐如何与后续记忆相关。在事件开始时，被记住的事件表现出伽马功率降低和海马-额叶同步增加。在事件内部，记忆由时间伽马功率增加和海马-颞叶伽马同步增加所预测，这与信息的渐进绑定一致。在事件结束时，记忆反映为海马θ功率增加和相位重置。这些结果共同为大脑如何在自然环境中支持记忆提供了新视角，表明它并不依赖于单一持续的编码状态。相反，它需要跨脑区和事件阶段的振荡状态的时间协调，其中稳定状态支持持续表征，而短暂的、边界驱动的海马-皮层网络重组则在存储已完成事件和编码下一事件之间切换系统。意义声明关于脑节律如何支持记忆的理论一直假设存在单一最优的编码新信息的大脑状态，这基于呈现离散项目（如词语或图像）的研究。然而，现实世界体验是连续的：事件随时间展开，并被编码为相连的记忆痕迹。通过在患者观看并回忆一部50分钟电影时记录其大脑电活动，我们发现记住一个事件并不依赖于一个静态编码状态，而是依赖于随着事件开始、展开和结束而变化的一系列动态脑节律和海马-皮层协调。这些发现表明，以往的离散项目范式仅捕捉了记忆形成中一个步骤的快照，并揭示了大脑如何将连续体验转化为持久记忆。

papers.title: Sex-Related Associations Between Precuneus Volume and Subjective-Objective Memory Discrepancy in Amyloid-Positive Individuals
papers.translated_title: 淀粉样蛋白阳性个体中楔前叶体积与主客观记忆差异的性别相关关联
papers.author: Akzam-Ouellette, M.-A.
papers.summary: INTRODUCTIONThe precuneus, a metamemory-related parietal region with sex-specific vulnerability in Alzheimers disease (AD), may contribute to reduced insight of memory deficit. We investigated whether precuneus structural integrity explained sex differences in subjective-objective memory discrepancy. METHODSPrecuneus volumes, as well as three other control regions, were acquired in 350 A{beta}+ and 310 A{beta}-participants from the ADNI dataset to quantify within-individual changes in subjective-objective memory discrepancy across AD progression. RESULTSA{beta}+ participants exhibited steeper objective memory decline ({beta} = -0.446, p < 0.001) despite stable subjective complaints ({beta} = -0.027, p = 0.587), resulting in a widening subjective-objective memory discrepancy ({beta} = 0.317, p < 0.001). In this group, only precuneus atrophy showed a sex-dependent association with discrepancy ({beta} = 0.508, p = 0.002), a finding absent in the A{beta}- group or other brain regions. DISCUSSIONThe precuneus represents a neuroanatomical substrate associated with sex-related differences in metacognitive vulnerability in A{beta}+ individuals.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：楔前叶是一个与元记忆相关的顶叶区域，在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中具有性别特异性易感性，可能参与记忆缺陷自知力下降。我们研究了楔前叶结构完整性是否解释了主观-客观记忆差异中的性别差异。方法：从ADNI数据集中获取350名A{beta}+和310名A{beta}-参与者的楔前叶体积以及另外三个对照区域，以量化AD进展过程中个体内主观-客观记忆差异的变化。结果：A{beta}+参与者表现出更陡峭的客观记忆下降（{beta} = -0.446，p < 0.001），尽管主观抱怨保持稳定（{beta} = -0.027，p = 0.587），导致主观-客观记忆差异扩大（{beta} = 0.317，p < 0.001）。在该组中，仅楔前叶萎缩显示出与差异的性别依赖性关联（{beta} = 0.508，p = 0.002），这一发现在A{beta}-组或其他脑区中不存在。讨论：楔前叶代表了与A{beta}+个体中元认知脆弱性性别相关差异有关的神经解剖学基础。

papers.title: Mapping the neural circuitry of cognitive restructuring in depressive and anxiety disorders
papers.translated_title: 绘制抑郁和焦虑障碍中认知重评的神经环路图谱
papers.author: Jamieson, A. J.
papers.summary: Cognitive restructuring, the process of identifying and challenging negative thoughts, is a key technique in the treatment of depressive and anxiety disorders. However, findings regarding its underlying neural circuitry remain inconsistent, potentially reflecting opposing effects of depressive and anxiety symptomatology that obscure disorder-specific dysfunction. A transdiagnostic sample of 73 clinical participants, predominantly with depressive or anxiety disorders, and 70 healthy controls completed a cognitive restructuring paradigm during 7 Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). We undertook a multimodal characterisation of the restructuring process, integrating behavioural, physiological, and neuroimaging measures. Group-level fMRI analyses examined how depressive and anxiety symptom severity related to brain activation, while dynamic causal modelling characterised the directional neural influences between implicated regions. During challenging compared to repeating statements, greater depressive symptoms were associated with reduced left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) activation. Conversely, greater anxiety symptoms were associated with greater dlPFC activation. Effective connectivity results revealed that depressive symptoms were associated with greater inhibition from the left ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (vlPFC) to the ventromedial prefrontal cortex, whereas anxiety symptoms were associated with greater excitation from the left dlPFC to amygdala and greater inhibition from the left vlPFC to amygdala. These symptoms additionally demonstrated a differential relationship with heart rate. While clinical participants modified negative beliefs as effectively as healthy controls, depressive and anxiety symptoms were associated with differential neural signatures during restructuring. This suggests that cognitive behavioural therapy may engage partially distinct mechanisms depending on symptom profile.

papers.title: Terminal Schwann Cells Are Required for Presynaptic Vesicle Homeostasis but Not for Gross Neuromuscular Junction Architecture in Mice
papers.translated_title: 终末施万细胞是小鼠突触前囊泡稳态所必需的，但对神经肌肉接头总体结构并非必需
papers.author: Kim, H.
papers.summary: Terminal Schwann cells (tSCs) are specialized glial cells persistently residing at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ), where they are widely held to participate in synaptic transmission and maintenance. However, elucidating their precise in vivo roles has been hindered by a lack of models for tSC-specific genetic manipulation, as conventional tools simultaneously targeted axonal Schwann cells. Here, we identify Col20a1 as a gene highly specific to tSCs through single-cell transcriptomic analysis and generate a novel Col20a1-CreERT2 knock-in mouse model. Utilizing this model, we achieved systemic labeling and ablation of tSCs during the postnatal maturation window. Surprisingly, systemic tSC loss disrupted neither gross NMJ architecture nor overall motor behavior. Instead, electrophysiological and ultrastructural analyses revealed presynaptic defects, characterized by increased frequency and reduced amplitude of spontaneous miniature endplate potentials (mEPPs), accelerated synaptic depression during high-frequency stimulation, and reduction of presynaptic vesicle density. Together, our findings establish Col20a1 as a genetic handle for tSC research and show that tSCs are required for presynaptic vesicle homeostasis rather than maintaining the gross architecture of the synapse.
papers.translated_summary: 终末施万细胞（tSCs）是持续存在于神经肌肉接头（NMJ）处的特化胶质细胞，人们普遍认为其参与突触传递与维持。然而，由于缺乏针对tSC特异性遗传操作的工具模型——传统工具会同时靶向轴突施万细胞——阐明其在体内的精确作用一直受到阻碍。在此，我们通过单细胞转录组分析鉴定出Col20a1是tSCs高度特异性的基因，并构建了一种新型Col20a1-CreERT2敲入小鼠模型。利用该模型，我们在出生后成熟窗口期实现了对tSCs的系统性标记与消融。令人意外的是，系统性tSC缺失既未破坏NMJ总体结构，也未影响整体运动行为。相反，电生理与超微结构分析揭示了突触前缺陷，其特征为自发微终板电位（mEPPs）频率增加且幅度降低、高频刺激下突触抑制加速以及突触前囊泡密度降低。综上所述，我们的研究确立了Col20a1作为tSC研究的遗传学工具，并表明tSCs是突触前囊泡稳态所必需的，而非维持突触的总体结构。

papers.title: Olfactory-Visual Integration Facilitates Scene Perception through Modulation of the Parahippocampal Place Area
papers.translated_title: 嗅觉-视觉整合通过调节海马旁回位置区促进场景感知
papers.author: Wang, Y.
papers.summary: Visual scenes anchor our experience of the world, yet the places in which scenes unfold are defined not only by what we see but also by what we smell. Whether and how odors contribute to the neural representation of visual scenes remains poorly understood. Here we asked whether a semantically congruent odor facilitates scene perception and identified the neural mechanisms supporting this facilitation. In two behavioral experiments, participants judged whether briefly presented, masked images depicted intact or scrambled scenes while continuously smelling an odor. A congruent odor lowered the exposure duration needed for accurate scene detection, and a placebo experiment, in which participants merely believed they were smelling an odor, failed to reproduce this benefit, indicating that the facilitation depends on actual sensory input rather than semantic priming. In an fMRI experiment, congruent odors enhanced responses and sharpened category-level scene representations in the parahippocampal place area (PPA), with the congruency-driven enhancement localized to the same anterior subregion that encoded scene identity. A conjunction analysis revealed superadditive responses to congruent odor-scene pairs in the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) and hippocampus, and psychophysiological interaction analyses showed that congruent stimulation strengthened functional coupling among the OFC, PPA, and piriform cortex. Notably, the piriform cortex decoded visual scene identity after congruent odor-scene pairing, suggesting that odor-scene binding extends scene representations into primary olfactory cortex. Together, these findings identify the PPA as a site where olfactory signals refine the neural code for visual scenes and reveal an OFC-coordinated piriform-OFC-PPA network through which smell shapes our sense of place.
papers.translated_summary: 视觉场景锚定了我们对世界的体验，然而场景展开的地点不仅由我们所看到的定义，也由我们所闻到的定义。气味是否以及如何参与视觉场景的神经表征仍知之甚少。在此，我们探究了语义一致的气味是否促进场景知觉，并识别了支持这一促进作用的神经机制。在两项行为实验中，参与者在持续闻一种气味的同时，判断短暂呈现的掩蔽图像描绘的是完整场景还是打乱场景。一致的气味降低了准确检测场景所需的呈现时长，而一项安慰剂实验——参与者仅仅相信自己闻到了气味——未能重现这一益处，表明该促进作用依赖于实际的感觉输入而非语义启动。在一项fMRI实验中，一致的气味增强了旁海马回位置区（PPA）的反应并锐化了类别层面的场景表征，且一致性驱动的增强定位于编码场景身份的同一前部亚区。联合分析揭示了眶额皮层（OFC）和海马对一致气味-场景配对的超加性反应，心理生理交互分析表明一致刺激增强了OFC、PPA和梨状皮层之间的功能耦合。值得注意的是，在一致气味-场景配对后，梨状皮层能够解码视觉场景身份，表明气味-场景绑定将场景表征扩展到初级嗅觉皮层。总之，这些发现将PPA确定为嗅觉信号精炼视觉场景神经编码的位点，并揭示了一个由OFC协调的梨状-OFC-PPA网络，气味通过该网络塑造我们的地点感。

papers.title: A Deep Learning Model for Quantifying and Mapping Human Spiral Ganglion Neurons (SGNs): The SGN Base Model
papers.translated_title: 用于量化和映射人类螺旋神经节神经元（SGNs）的深度学习模型：SGN基础模型
papers.author: Hall, A. K.
papers.summary: IntroductionSpiral ganglion neurons (SGNs) transmit auditory information and are a histological marker that have been quantified for decades to study various hearing loss pathologies in human temporal bone (hTB) specimens. Historically, quantification of SGNs has been labor-intensive and subject to manual bias and error. With the advent of digital microscopy, this study introduces and assesses the accuracy of a deep learning model for SGN quantification, providing an efficient approach that enables in-depth analysis of SGN distribution through three-dimensional frequency mapping. MethodsDigitized mid-modiolar slides from six hTBs from the Mass Eye and Ear Otopathology Laboratory Collection, representing a range of ages, post-mortem times, and diagnoses, were selected to train a computer vision model. Using Dragonfly 2024.1, the nucleus and cytoplasm of each SGN were manually segmented against background and used as the training corpus. The model was systemically evaluated in eighteen new cases to assess its accuracy across diverse histopathological presentations. For the specimen with the lowest performance, five small regions were manually annotated to augment the training dataset to evaluate the adaptability of the model. Next, the model was applied to every available slide that includes Rosenthals canal for a single case to assess model performance throughout the entire cochlea. Model performance was evaluated by comparing model SGN counts with counts by an experienced investigator, classifying each model prediction as a true positive, false positive, or false negative. Using coordinates output by the model, three-dimensional reconstructions were generated to analyze model performance from base to apex. ResultsA U-Net convolutional neural network was developed with an average Dice coefficient of 0.91. Across eighteen cases representing diverse SGN morphologies and densities, the model achieved an F1-score of 0.91. For the case with the lowest performance, fine-tuning the model by adding additional training data from the same case improved the r2 value from 0.919 to 0.996. When applied to all available slides from a single case, the model achieved an F1-score of 0.96 across the entire cochlea. ConclusionWe present the pretrained SGN Base Model: an approach for quantifying SGNs in hTB specimens that improves efficiency while maintaining high accuracy in comparison to manual quantification. The model performs robustly throughout the cochlea and is adaptable to a diverse range of archival hTB specimens with variable SGN densities and morphologies. Model-generated spatial coordinates for each SGN enable three-dimensional analysis and detailed mapping of SGN density from base to apex.
papers.translated_summary: 引言螺旋神经节神经元（SGNs）传递听觉信息，是数十年来用于研究人类颞骨（hTB）标本中各种听力损失病理的定量组织学标志物。历史上，SGN的定量工作劳动强度大，且易受人工偏差和误差的影响。随着数字显微镜的出现，本研究引入并评估了一种用于SGN定量的深度学习模型的准确性，提供了一种高效方法，可通过三维频率映射对SGN分布进行深入分析。方法从Mass Eye and Ear Otopathology Laboratory Collection的六例hTB中选取数字化的中轴切片，涵盖不同年龄、死后时间和诊断，用于训练计算机视觉模型。使用Dragonfly 2024.1，将每个SGN的细胞核和细胞质针对背景进行手动分割，并用作训练语料库。该模型在十八个新病例中进行了系统评估，以评估其在不同组织病理学表现中的准确性。对于表现最低的标本，手动标注五个小区域以扩充训练数据集，以评估模型的适应性。接下来，将该模型应用于单个病例中包含Rosenthal管的每张可用切片，以评估模型在整个耳蜗中的性能。模型性能通过将模型SGN计数与经验丰富的研究者的计数进行比较来评估，将每个模型预测分类为真阳性、假阳性或假阴性。利用模型输出的坐标，生成三维重建以分析模型从基底到顶部的性能。结果开发了一个U-Net卷积神经网络，平均Dice系数为0.91。在代表不同SGN形态和密度的十八个病例中，模型达到了0.91的F1分数。对于表现最低的病例，通过添加来自同一病例的额外训练数据对模型进行微调，将r2值从0.919提高到0.996。当应用于单个病例的所有可用切片时，模型在整个耳蜗中达到了0.96的F1分数。结论我们提出了预训练的SGN基础模型：一种用于定量hTB标本中SGN的方法，与手动定量相比，在保持高准确性的同时提高了效率。该模型在整个耳蜗中表现稳健，并且适用于具有不同SGN密度和形态的多种档案hTB标本。模型生成的每个SGN的空间坐标使得能够进行三维分析以及从基底到顶部的SGN密度详细映射。

papers.title: Incidence and outcome of intracerebral hemorrhage in a prospective cohort and healthcare data.
papers.translated_title: 前瞻性队列和医疗数据中脑出血的发病率和结局。
papers.author: Hosking, A.
papers.summary: Background: The global burden of intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) remains high. Identifying trends in incidence and outcome requires resource-intensive epidemiological surveillance. Our objective was to characterise incidence, survival and functional outcome of people with ICH in a cohort study; and compare to healthcare systems data (HSD) in the same region. Methods: We conducted a prospective population-based inception cohort study in Lothian, Scotland, UK (the Lothian Audit of Treatment of ICH, LATCH). LATCH included all spontaneous non-traumatic ICH in Lothian residents [≥]16 years between 1st June 2010 - 31st May 2013 and 1st November 2018 - 31st October 2021. We identified and characterized people with ICH in HSD in the same region and period using linked primary and secondary care records, community prescriptions and death records. We calculated incidence per 100,000 person-years; 30-day survival; and sensitivity and positive predictive value of ICH detection in HSD. For functional outcome one year after ICH, we compared the modified Rankin Scale score (mRS) in LATCH to days alive and out of hospital in HSD. Results: In LATCH, from 1283 possible cases, 1021 were first-ever ICH. We identified 876 people with ICH in HSD in the same period. In LATCH, ICH incidence was 23.7 (95%CI 22.2-25.2) per 100,000 person-years (48.5% male, mean age 72 (SD 14.6) years), with no time trend (trend in crude incidence rates 0.31/year (-3.78-4.39)). ICH incidence in HSD was 23.1 (21.6-24.6) per 100,000 person-years (48.3% male, mean age 74.2 (SD 14.0) years). The positive predictive value of ICH identified in HSD versus LATCH was 78.3% (75.4%-81.0%). 30-day case fatality was 41.2% (38.1%-44.2%) in LATCH and 39.0% (35.5%-42.3%) in HSD. We found good correlation between functional outcome measures (Spearman's r=0.88, p<0.001). Conclusions: The burden of ICH remains persistently high. HSD appears accurate for assessing incidence, survival and functional outcome.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：全球脑出血（ICH）负担仍然很高。识别发病率和结局趋势需要资源密集型的流行病学监测。我们的目标是在一项队列研究中描述ICH患者的发病率、生存率和功能结局特征，并与同一地区的医疗系统数据（HSD）进行比较。方法：我们在英国苏格兰洛锡安开展了一项前瞻性基于人群的起始队列研究（洛锡安ICH治疗审计，LATCH）。LATCH纳入了2010年6月1日至2013年5月31日以及2018年11月1日至2021年10月31日期间洛锡安居民中所有年龄≥16岁的自发性非创伤性ICH。我们使用关联的初级和二级医疗记录、社区处方和死亡记录，识别并描述了同一地区和时间段内HSD中的ICH患者。我们计算了每10万人年的发病率、30天生存率以及HSD中ICH检测的敏感度和阳性预测值。对于ICH后一年的功能结局，我们将LATCH中的改良Rankin量表评分（mRS）与HSD中的存活且未住院天数进行了比较。结果：在LATCH中，从1283例可能病例中，1021例为首次ICH。我们在同一时期的HSD中识别出876例ICH患者。在LATCH中，ICH发病率为每10万人年23.7例（95%CI 22.2-25.2）（48.5%为男性，平均年龄72岁（SD 14.6）），无时间趋势（粗发病率趋势为每年0.31（-3.78-4.39））。HSD中ICH发病率为每10万人年23.1例（21.6-24.6）（48.3%为男性，平均年龄74.2岁（SD 14.0））。HSD中识别的ICH相对于LATCH的阳性预测值为78.3%（75.4%-81.0%）。30天病死率在LATCH中为41.2%（38.1%-44.2%），在HSD中为39.0%（35.5%-42.3%）。我们发现功能结局指标之间具有良好的相关性（Spearman's r=0.88，p<0.001）。结论：ICH负担持续居高不下。HSD在评估发病率、生存率和功能结局方面似乎是准确的。

papers.title: Final Days with Advanced Heart Failure: Facility Variation in Home Time and Hospice Enrollment
papers.translated_title: 晚期心力衰竭的最后时光：居家时间与临终关怀入组情况的机构差异
papers.author: Ouyang, N.
papers.summary: Background: Days spent at home and hospice enrollment describe different but potentially related aspects of high-quality end-of-life care for people with advanced heart failure (aHF). However, how much variation in these quality outcomes exists and what drives between-facility differences is unknown. Methods: This retrospective cohort study included people with aHF at 119 Veterans Affairs medical centers (VAMCs) who died in 2022-2023. Outcomes were days at home during the last 90 days of life and hospice enrollment. Multilevel linear and logistic regression models with facility random intercepts quantified between-facility variation before and after adjustment for patient characteristics, facility complexity, and facility volume. Results: The cohort included 10,114 decedents (mean [standard deviation, SD] age, 76.5 [9.6] years; 98.2% male). Patients spent a mean (SD) of 59.4 (29.9) days at home during their final 90 days of life, and 4521 (44.7%) enrolled in hospice. For days at home, the adjusted intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) was 0.95%. The adjusted median difference between two randomly selected VAMCs was 2.7 days (95% CI, 2.0-3.7). Measured patient and facility characteristics explained 29% of the between-facility variance. For hospice enrollment, the adjusted ICC was 3.6%. The adjusted median odds ratio was 1.40 (95% CI, 1.31-1.51), indicating a median 40% higher odds of hospice use when comparing two similar patients treated at two randomly selected VAMCs. Between-facility variance increased 15.0% after adjustment for patient characteristics, facility complexity, and volume. Conclusions: People with aHF spent one-third of their final 90 days of life in institutional settings; fewer than half received hospice. Adjusted home time differed little across VAMCs, while hospice enrollment varied substantially. Persistent variation in hospice enrollment suggests that interventions targeting facility-level care processes, such as referral practices, could improve hospice utilization among people with aHF.

papers.title: PBMC transcriptional and plasma chemokine profiles show differential associations with the presence and burden of coronary artery calcification
papers.translated_title: PBMC转录谱和血浆趋化因子谱与冠状动脉钙化的存在及负荷表现出不同的关联
papers.author: Igual-Dominguez, A.
papers.summary: Background: Coronary artery calcium (CAC) reflects atherosclerotic burden. We examined whether peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) expression of calcium-regulatory and chemotactic-receptor genes and plasma chemokine concentrations were associated with CAC presence and with its extent among adults with detectable calcification. Methods: This single-center, cross-sectional study included 53 adults undergoing coronary computed tomography, 27 with CAC=0 and 26 with CAC>0. We measured 10 PBMC transcripts by reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction and 8 plasma chemokines by multiplex immunoassay. We assessed associations using permutation tests, composite indices, and compartment-specific principal component analyses. Results: All 10 PBMC transcripts correlated positively with CAC after false discovery rate correction. Associations were strongest for S100A9 (rho=+0.69), S100A8 and CXCR2 (both rho=+0.66), and CCR2 (rho=+0.65). Plasma CX3CL1, CXCL2, CXCL16, and CXCL12 were lower in participants with detectable CAC, whereas CXCL1 was higher and correlated with PBMC CXCR2 expression (rho=+0.66, p<0.001). Most molecular differences distinguished participants with and without CAC. In exploratory analyses among participants with detectable CAC, CCR2 expression (rho=+0.43, p=0.043), the chemotactic-receptor index (rho=0.51, p=0.022), and plasma CXCL1 (rho=+0.42, p=0.034) correlated with CAC burden. Additional adjustment for diabetes or hypertension attenuated selected associations. Conclusions: Detectable coronary calcification was associated with coordinated differences in PBMC gene expression and a distinct plasma chemokine profile. CCR2 expression, the receptor index, and plasma CXCL1 warrant further study in relation to the extent of calcification.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：冠状动脉钙化（CAC）反映动脉粥样硬化负荷。我们研究了外周血单核细胞（PBMC）中钙调节基因和趋化因子受体基因的表达以及血浆趋化因子浓度是否与CAC的存在及其在可检测到钙化的成年人中的范围相关。方法：这项单中心横断面研究纳入了53名接受冠状动脉计算机断层扫描的成年人，其中27人CAC=0，26人CAC>0。我们通过逆转录定量聚合酶链反应测量了10种PBMC转录本，通过多重免疫测定法测量了8种血浆趋化因子。我们使用置换检验、复合指数和区室特异性主成分分析评估了关联。结果：经错误发现率校正后，所有10种PBMC转录本均与CAC呈正相关。关联最强的是S100A9（rho=+0.69）、S100A8和CXCR2（两者rho=+0.66）以及CCR2（rho=+0.65）。在可检测到CAC的参与者中，血浆CX3CL1、CXCL2、CXCL16和CXCL12较低，而CXCL1较高并与PBMC CXCR2表达相关（rho=+0.66，p<0.001）。大多数分子差异区分了有和无CAC的参与者。在可检测到CAC的参与者中的探索性分析中，CCR2表达（rho=+0.43，p=0.043）、趋化因子受体指数（rho=0.51，p=0.022）和血浆CXCL1（rho=+0.42，p=0.034）与CAC负荷相关。对糖尿病或高血压的额外调整减弱了部分关联。结论：可检测到的冠状动脉钙化与PBMC基因表达的协调差异以及独特的血浆趋化因子谱相关。CCR2表达、受体指数和血浆CXCL1值得进一步研究与钙化范围的关系。

papers.title: Comparing 5-year survival between surgeons within pathological stage after gastric cancer resection: a single-center cohort study (the SAH framework)

papers.author: Sah, B. K.
papers.summary: Background: Long-term survival and major postoperative morbidity matter most to patients after cancer surgery, yet surgeon-level outcomes are rarely audited within pathological stage. We evaluated the Surgical Assessment in Healthcare framework, a stage-specific dual-outcome audit, at one center. Methods: We studied 690 consecutive curative gastrectomies for Stage I to III gastric adenocarcinoma performed in 2019 by eight high-volume gastrointestinal oncology consultants (complete 5-year follow-up). The primary cohort included 570 surgery-first patients; 120 neoadjuvant patients entered sensitivity analysis. Co-primary outcomes were 5-year overall survival and major postoperative morbidity. Expected outcomes came from stage-stratified models fitted to all other surgeons' patients (adjusted for age, sex, tumor location, size, and grade), with exact 95% confidence intervals and two-sided Holm adjustment across 23 exploratory tests. Results: Among 570 patients, 118 (20.7%) died within 5 years and 37 (6.5%) experienced major morbidity. Overall surgeon observed-to-expected mortality ratios ranged from 0.77 to 1.62; neither overall mortality nor major morbidity differed after adjustment. One group differed: surgeon S6 in Stage II (9 observed versus 2.3 expected deaths among 20 patients; ratio 3.96, exact 95% confidence interval 2.11 to 5.90; exploratory Holm-adjusted P = 0.004), persisting across sensitivity analyses. Stage III showed no variation. Detecting doubled mortality with 80% power requires about 11 expected deaths per prespecified group (21 Holm-adjusted). Conclusion: Stage-specific surgeon auditing of 5-year survival and major morbidity is feasible from routine data, but a single center reliably detects only large differences; routine use requires multi-year or multi-center pooling.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：长期生存和主要术后并发症是癌症手术后患者最关心的问题，但外科医生层面的结局很少在病理分期内部进行审计。我们在一个中心评估了医疗保健中的外科评估框架，这是一种特定分期的双结局审计。方法：我们研究了2019年由八位高容量胃肠肿瘤顾问连续实施的690例根治性胃切除术，用于I至III期胃腺癌（完整5年随访）。主要队列包括570例手术优先患者；120例新辅助患者进入敏感性分析。共同主要结局为5年总生存率和主要术后并发症。预期结局来自根据其他外科医生患者拟合的分期分层模型（调整年龄、性别、肿瘤位置、大小和分级），并给出精确95%置信区间和23项探索性检验的双侧Holm校正。结果：在570例患者中，118例（20.7%）在5年内死亡，37例（6.5%）发生主要并发症。总体外科医生观察与预期死亡率比值范围为0.77至1.62；调整后总体死亡率或主要并发症均无差异。一组存在差异：S6外科医生在II期（20例患者中9例观察死亡对2.3例预期死亡；比值3.96，精确95%置信区间2.11至5.90；探索性Holm校正P = 0.004），在敏感性分析中持续存在。III期未见变异。以80%把握度检测死亡率翻倍，每个预设组需要约11例预期死亡（21项Holm校正）。结论：基于常规数据对5年生存率和主要并发症进行特定分期的外科医生审计是可行的，但单个中心只能可靠检测较大差异；常规使用需要多年或多中心汇总。

papers.title: Performance Characteristics of Reasoning Large Language Models for Evidence Extraction from Clinical Genomics Literature
papers.translated_title: 推理大语言模型从临床基因组学文献中提取证据的性能特征
papers.author: Murugan, M.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND Genetic variant curation requires literature-guided comparison of variant prevalence in affected individuals versus healthy controls. This evidence is categorized as the PS4 evidence code by the AMP/ACMG variant interpretation guidelines and its manual extraction is a major bottleneck in clinical variant curation. We evaluated whether reasoning-capable large language models (LLMs) can support guideline-constrained PS4 evidence extraction from literature. METHODS We benchmarked twelve reasoning-capable LLMs spanning providers, capability tiers, and releases on 281 publication-variant pairs against an expert-curated truth-set. Models performed variant detection (Task 1) and PS4-eligible proband counting under ACMG/AMP and gene-specific ClinGen Variant Curation Expert Panel guidance (Task 2). Six newer models also underwent variant-level PS4 strength assignment (Task 3). We compared guideline-informed and minimal baseline prompts, categorized errors by blinded dual review, and assessed model performance, reproducibility, cost, and latency. RESULTS Task 1 concordance was 93.2-99.6%, with 10 of 12 models exceeding 96%. Task 2 exact-count concordance was 72.2-92.2%, and Task 3 was 71.4-92.9%. Removing guidance minimally affected Task 1 but reduced Task 2 concordance by 14.6-33.1 points in all six newer models, with the largest losses in lower-performing baseline models. Variant-mapping errors decreased in newer releases, whereas phenotype-eligibility and case-independence errors persisted. Five of six newer models were statistically indistinguishable on Task 2; with only the smallest model lagging. Among those five, cost varied 6.9-fold and latency 2.9-fold. CONCLUSIONS Reasoning-capable LLMs can support automation of guideline-based PS4 evidence extraction, achieving high concordance with expert curation. Performance depends on supplying relevant guidelines and errors more often involve guideline application than evidence identification. Residual phenotype and case-independence errors support a hybrid workflow with expert review, while statistically comparable performance among five newer models suggests that cost, latency, and availability may be relevant considerations when selecting among similarly performing models.

papers.title: Multiscale connectomes reveal stage-dependent organization of cortical atrophy in Alzheimer's disease
papers.translated_title: 多尺度连接组揭示阿尔茨海默病皮层萎缩的阶段依赖性组织
papers.author: Gao, K.
papers.summary: INTRODUCTION: Alzheimer's disease (AD) manifests a specific spatial progression pattern, but its propagation mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: We employed nine brain connectomes spanning multiple biological levels to investigate the mechanisms underlying cortical atrophy propagation in AD. Individual gray matter atrophy maps were quantified using normative modeling and were then mapped onto the connectomes by assessing the relationship between regional atrophy and the atrophy of neighboring regions defined by each connectome. RESULTS: Cross-sectionally, node-neighbor relationship was weak in the preclinical stage, suggesting limited influence of connectome architecture. Longitudinally, atrophy became progressively more aligned with the neurotransmitter receptor similarity connectome in individuals with MCI converting to AD dementia and dementia patients. DISCUSSION: Our findings described a stage-dependent shift in cortical atrophy propagation, with neurotransmitter receptor similarity playing an increasing role as AD progresses.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：阿尔茨海默病（AD）表现出特定的空间进展模式，但其传播机制仍不清楚。方法：我们采用了涵盖多个生物学层次的九个脑连接组，以探究AD中皮层萎缩传播的机制。个体灰质萎缩图谱通过规范建模进行量化，随后通过评估区域萎缩与由每个连接组定义的邻近区域萎缩之间的关系，将其映射到连接组上。结果：在横断面上，临床前阶段的节点-邻居关系较弱，提示连接组架构的影响有限。在纵向上，随着轻度认知障碍（MCI）转化为AD痴呆的个体及痴呆患者，萎缩逐渐与神经递质受体相似性连接组更加一致。讨论：我们的发现描述了皮层萎缩传播的阶段依赖性转变，随着AD进展，神经递质受体相似性发挥着越来越大的作用。

papers.title: Scalp EEG seizure warning in children under a pre-specified, locked evaluation: confound audit, structured chance levels and a negative result
papers.translated_title: 儿童头皮脑电图癫痫发作预警在预先设定并锁定的评估下：混杂因素审查、结构化偶然水平与阴性结果
papers.author: Chen, M.
papers.summary: Objective. Reported performance of scalp electroencephalographic (EEG) seizure prediction is often inflated by lenient evaluation and by the vigilance-state, clock-time and admission-trend structure of monitoring data. We asked how much short-horizon warning survives a pre-specified, locked evaluation. Approach. Continuous video-EEG from 21 monitored children (1315 h) formed the development cohort. A statistical-process-control warning method was evaluated under a written protocol, then re-designed as a state-conditioned, directional scheme on seven global EEG features, frozen with a hash-recorded configuration and time-stamped pre-specification, assessed by nested leave-one-patient-out cross-validation, and applied once to two validation cohorts (a second batch from the same unit and the public CHB-MIT database from Children's Hospital Boston; 101 evaluable seizures). Main results. The original method detected 44% of evaluable seizures at 0.48 false alarms per hour, no better than a random predictor (51%, p = 0.86); its statistic moved three times more with vigilance state than with seizure approach. The frozen scheme detected 15 of 45 development seizures (33%) at 0.47 false alarms per hour, above analytic (21%, p = 0.034) and permutation chance, but a predictor using only clock time, vigilance state and days since admission reproduced most of this, and the signal was confined to the last 30 min. In validation it detected 19 seizures (19%) at 0.60 false alarms per hour against 26% chance (p = 0.96); no secondary endpoint was met, and with the child as the unit of analysis no cohort was above chance. Significance. Vigilance state, clock time and admission trend inflate apparent warning performance unless the chance model preserves that structure, and the short-horizon signal did not generalise beyond its development cohort. Scalp-EEG warning should be evaluated under pre-specified rules against structured chance levels; the frozen scheme and framework are offered as a reference.
papers.translated_summary: 目的。头皮脑电图（EEG）癫痫发作预测的已报告性能常因宽松评估以及监测数据中的警觉状态、时钟时间和入院趋势结构而被夸大。我们探究在预先设定、锁定的评估下，短时程预警还能保留多少。方法。来自21名受监测儿童的连续视频脑电图（1315小时）构成开发队列。一种统计过程控制预警方法在书面方案下接受评估，随后被重新设计为基于七个全局EEG特征的状态条件化、方向性方案，以哈希记录的配置和时间戳预设定冻结，通过嵌套留一患者交叉验证进行评估，并一次性应用于两个验证队列（同一单位的第二批数据以及来自波士顿儿童医院的公开CHB-MIT数据库；101次可评估发作）。主要结果。原始方法在每小时0.48次误报下检测到44%的可评估发作，并不优于随机预测器（51%，p = 0.86）；其统计量随警觉状态的变化是随发作临近变化的三倍。冻结方案在每小时0.47次误报下检测到45次开发队列发作中的15次（33%），高于解析概率（21%，p = 0.034）和置换概率，但仅使用时钟时间、警觉状态和入院天数的预测器再现了其中大部分，且信号局限于最后30分钟。在验证中，其在每小时0.60次误报下检测到19次发作（19%），而随机概率为26%（p = 0.96）；未达到任何次要终点，且以儿童为分析单位时，无任何队列高于随机水平。意义。警觉状态、时钟时间和入院趋势会夸大表观预警性能，除非随机模型保留该结构，且短时程信号未能推广至其开发队列之外。头皮EEG预警应在预先设定的规则下、对照结构化随机水平进行评估；冻结方案和框架作为参考提供。

papers.title: Human genetic support improves the odds of drug success but poorly predicts it
papers.translated_title: 人类遗传学支持提高了药物成功的几率，但对其预测效果不佳
papers.author: Kohleick, L.
papers.summary: Nine in ten drug programmes that enter clinical trials fail, mostly for lack of efficacy1,2. Drug targets supported by human genetic evidence are about twice as likely to reach approval3-5, which now guides target selection. Yet most of it emerged only after the drugs had been developed, the methods linking genetic variants to genes were trained in part on known drug targets6, and recent trials of genetically supported targets have both lowered a disease marker7 and failed to reduce clinical events8,9. Here we tested how far genetic support can guide drug development across almost 17,000 target-disease pairs. Its association with clinical success held when genes were assigned without knowledge of drugs, within diseases and for evidence available years before a trial. It was strongest where the evidence pointed directly to the causal gene, larger for diseases judged on a measurable trait, and absent for drugs that use their target only to reach cells, such as antibody-drug conjugates. Genetic support, however, contributed little to distinguishing successful from failed programmes. Human genetic evidence is therefore a reliable but modest guide to where to invest, not a predictor of which programme will succeed.
papers.translated_summary: 进入临床试验的药物项目中，十有九个会失败，主要原因是缺乏疗效1,2。有人类遗传学证据支持的药物靶点获得批准的可能性大约翻倍3-5，这如今指导着靶点选择。然而，其中大部分证据只是在药物研发之后才出现，将遗传变异与基因联系起来的方法部分是在已知药物靶点上训练的6，而近期针对有遗传学支持的靶点的试验既降低了一项疾病标志物7，又未能减少临床事件8,9。在此，我们检验了遗传学支持能在多大程度上指导近17,000个靶点-疾病对的药物研发。当在不了解药物的情况下指派基因、在疾病内部以及对于试验多年前即可获得的证据时，其与临床成功的关联依然成立。当证据直接指向因果基因时关联最强，对于依据可测量性状评判的疾病关联更大，而对于仅利用其靶点到达细胞的药物（如抗体-药物偶联物）则不存在关联。然而，遗传学支持在区分成功与失败项目方面贡献甚微。因此，人类遗传学证据是指导投资方向的可靠但有限的指南，而非预测哪个项目会成功的指标。

papers.title: Genome-wide meta-analysis of shingles identifies eight susceptibility loci implicating antigen presentation and interferon signaling
papers.translated_title: 带状疱疹全基因组荟萃分析识别出八个易感位点，涉及抗原呈递和干扰素信号传导
papers.author: Haapaniemi, H.
papers.summary: Shingles (herpes zoster), caused by reactivation of varicella zoster virus (VZV), affects about one third of people during their lifetime, and host genetics contribute to susceptibility. We performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis across five cohorts comprising 70,216 cases and 1,646,257 controls of European ancestry. We identified eight genome-wide significant loci, replicating associations in the HLA region and near IFNA21 and identifying novel associations near BACH2, IFNAR2, RHOBTB1, KPNB1 and CPN1 and at the IGH locus. HLA fine-mapping identified eight independent allele signals, six at HLA-B, with the strongest protective association for HLA-B*44:02/B*44:27. Colocalization linked the risk alleles to lower expression of IFNAR2 in T cells, NK cells and skin, BACH2 in CD4 T cells, and IGHG1 and IGHG2 in B cells. These loci implicate MHC class I antigen presentation, type I interferon signaling, T-cell memory and humoral immunity. Shingles was genetically correlated with pain, infectious and immune-mediated diseases. In Mendelian randomization, genetic liability to shingles was associated with multiple sclerosis and systemic lupus erythematosus, but both associations depended on the MHC instrument, suggesting shared HLA effects. Genetic liability to pain was associated with higher shingles risk. These findings advance understanding of the genetic architecture of VZV reactivation.

papers.title: Temporal relationships between distress and pain in people living with HIV
papers.translated_title: HIV感染者痛苦与疼痛之间的时间关系
papers.author: Arendse, G.
papers.summary: Objective: There is a bidirectional relationship between emotional distress and pain. However, this relationship is understudied in people with HIV in low-resource settings. This study sought to describe the temporal relationship between emotional distress and pain in people with HIV. Design: Longitudinal observational study. Methods: Participants with virally suppressed HIV, who had previously reported either no pain or persistent pain, provided weekly remote ratings of distress, worst pain, and average pain using 0-10 visual analogue scales. Within-individual fluctuations in distress and pain were visualised over time. Cumulative link mixed models assessed concurrent and one-week-lagged associations between distress and worst or average pain. Results: 72 participants provided responses over 49 weeks. The participants had a median (IQR) age of 43 (37-51) years, 63% (n=45) were unemployed and most were females (n=51;71%). Distress was associated with concurrently reported worst pain and average pain intensity (odds ratios, ORs=1.85-2.08; based on 195 response pairs from 30 participants). Time-lagged analyses (146 response pairs from 27 participants) showed worst pain (OR=1.42, 95% CI=1.17-1.71, p<0.001) and average pain (OR=1.43, 95% CI=1.20-1.71, p<0.001) intensity to be associated with higher distress in the next week. Distress was associated with higher worst pain intensity (OR=1.25, 95% CI=1.07-1.46, p=0.023) but not average pain intensity in the next week. Conclusions: The temporal association between distress and worst pain intensity was bidirectional, whereas distress was not associated with average pain intensity in the next week. Both pain and emotional distress should receive attention from HIV research and clinical care in similar settings.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：情绪困扰与疼痛之间存在双向关系。然而，在资源匮乏地区的HIV感染者中，这一关系研究不足。本研究旨在描述HIV感染者情绪困扰与疼痛之间的时间关系。设计：纵向观察性研究。方法：病毒学抑制的HIV感染者，既往报告无疼痛或持续性疼痛，使用0-10视觉模拟量表每周远程提供困扰、最严重疼痛和平均疼痛评分。个体内困扰和疼痛的波动随时间可视化。累积连接混合模型评估困扰与最严重疼痛或平均疼痛之间的同时性和一周滞后关联。结果：72名参与者提供了49周的应答。参与者的中位（IQR）年龄为43（37-51）岁，63%（n=45）失业，大多数为女性（n=51；71%）。困扰与同时报告的最严重疼痛和平均疼痛强度相关（比值比，ORs=1.85-2.08；基于30名参与者的195对应答）。时间滞后分析（27名参与者的146对应答）显示，最严重疼痛（OR=1.42，95% CI=1.17-1.71，p<0.001）和平均疼痛（OR=1.43，95% CI=1.20-1.71，p<0.001）强度与下周更高的困扰相关。困扰与下周更高的最严重疼痛强度相关（OR=1.25，95% CI=1.07-1.46，p=0.023），但与平均疼痛强度无关。结论：困扰与最严重疼痛强度之间的时间关联是双向的，而困扰与下周平均疼痛强度无关。在类似环境中，疼痛和情绪困扰都应受到HIV研究和临床护理的关注。
